_source: Cyberpunk RED Core Rulebook, the gear list (pp. 353-355), as transcribed into catalog.json's gear descriptions. The bonuses are printed; this file only says which Skill ids each printed sentence names, so the roll can carry them.
_note: A carried item adds its printed bonus to a Check with a named Skill. Two of the same item do not stack, and the largest bonus per Skill applies. Conditional bonuses the rules leave to a GM (the Agent's '+2 to Wardrobe and Style under some circumstances') are left out rather than guessed at, because nothing in the engine can say when the circumstance holds.
_scopeNote: The Techscanner's printed '+2 to multiple TECH-based Skills' is read as the Tech repair Skills the rules name (Basic Tech, Cybertech, Electronics/Security Tech, Weaponstech, Land/Sea/Air Vehicle Tech) — the same list catalog.json's _rules.repairSkills cites. Confirm against the printed page.
